# Air Oasis

> > Air Oasis delivers advanced HEPA air purification and indoor air quality solutions through their flagship iAdaptAir product line, featuring bi-polar ionization and medical-grade filtration technology.

Air Oasis specializes in home and commercial air purifiers designed to address specific indoor air quality concerns including allergens, mold, viruses, bacteria, smoke, odors, and biotoxin illness. Their iAdaptAir series combines H13 HEPA filtration with innovative bi-polar ionization technology to provide comprehensive air purification across multiple room sizes.

## Key Topics

- iAdaptAir
- HEPA filtration
- Bi-polar ionization
- Indoor air quality

- Mold remediation

## iAdaptAir Product Line

- [iAdaptAir 2.0 Small](https://www.airoasis.com/products/iadaptair-2-0-small): Compact H13 HEPA air purifier with bi-polar ionization for small rooms
- [iAdaptAir 2.0 Medium](https://www.airoasis.com/products/iadaptair-2-0-medium): Mid-size HEPA purifier with smart home features for medium room coverage
- [iAdaptAir 2.0 Large](https://www.airoasis.com/products/iadaptair-2-0-large): High-capacity H13 HEPA purifier designed for large room and open spaces
- [iAdaptAir 2.0 Pro](https://www.airoasis.com/products/iadaptair-2-0-pro): Premium medical-grade HEPA air purifier with advanced filtration technology
- [AP094 HEPA Purifier](https://www.airoasis.com/products/air-oasis-ap094-hepa): Professional-grade HEPA purifier for spaces up to 875 sq ft
